newsitem.title: USA: SunResorts says lawsuit is groundless.
newsitem.headline: SunResorts says lawsuit is groundless.

text.p: SunResorts Ltd N.V. said on Monday that allegations made against the company in a lawsuit filed in New York Supreme Court are baseless and without merit.

The company said that suit, which was filed by the association representing the apartment owners at the Mullet Bay Resort & Casino in St. Maarten, seeks to give the association control over all insurance proceeds covering damages from Hurricanes Luis and Marilyn.
SunResorts, which owns the resort where the apartments are located, said that the lawsuit came as a complete surprise and that the company was not aware of any disputes between the parties.
